historical_record.description: A three-unit, three-story-over-garage building stood at 1155 Tennessee Street.

The City Planning Commission approved with amendments the conditional use authorization to convert a dwelling unit into office space on the second floor of a three-unit, three-story-over-garage building, closing the thread from the August 28 motion of intent.
